description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests to verify the correctness and safety of Git object handling, particularly focusing on buffer overflows and truncated object scenarios. It includes setup functions, test cases, and validation logic to ensure Git's hash-object functionality handles malformed inputs correctly.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating or clearing the 'base' file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line to the 'base' file, representing a Git object with specified type and SHA1.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Runs a test to verify that certain corrupted or truncated object data fails to produce a valid hash, indicating proper buffer overrun protections.

methods.name: ident_checks
methods.description: Performs a series of checks on commit or tag objects to validate email and date fields handling.
